name: PaymentCard
label: Payment card
description: The face of a payment card at a card’s aspect ratio, with the brand, last four digits, holder, expiry and a frozen state.

props.name: brand
props.description: The issuer's wordmark or logo, at the top start of the face. Text, or a node such as an `` with its own alt text. When it is text it also opens the card's accessible name.

props.name: holderName
props.description: The name printed on the card, at the bottom start.

props.name: last4
props.description: The last four digits of the card number, drawn as `•• 5555`.

props.name: expiry
props.description: When the card expires, written in `locale` as a two-digit month and year.

props.name: network
props.description: The card network's mark at the bottom end, such as a logo `` with its alt text.

props.name: label
props.description: A tier or kind printed at the top end, such as "Plus" or "Virtual".

props.name: tone
props.description:
The face's colour: `default` is the solid inverse face a card reads as
in a wallet, `neutral` a quieter face on the container ramp.

props.name: frozen
props.description: Draws the card frozen: the face dimmed under a lock and the frozen label.

props.name: size
props.description: The face's width step; the height follows from the card's aspect ratio.

props.name: locale
props.description:
The BCP 47 locale the expiry is written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to
`en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes
the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.

props.name: endingInLabel
props.description: Read before the last four digits, out of sight. Default "ending in".

props.name: expiresLabel
props.description: Read before the expiry, out of sight. Default "Expires".

props.name: frozenLabel
props.description: Shown over a frozen face. Default "Frozen".

props.name: cardLabel
props.description:
The card's accessible name, written from its parts. Default: the brand
when it is text, then "card ending in 5555, Jordan Reyes".
props.defaultExpression:
({ brand, holderName, last4 }: PaymentCardLabelParts) =>
  `${brand ? `${brand} card` : 'Card'} ending in ${last4}, ${holderName}`

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the face

PaymentCardExpiry.definition: type PaymentCardExpiry = { month: number; year: number };
PaymentCardExpiry.description: A card's expiry: the month (1 to 12) and the full year.

PaymentCardLabelParts.description: What the default accessible name is written from.

alternatives.name: Card
alternatives.when: the tile previews any other content, or links to a page
